issues.description: The problem statement (UML and task text) and the template declare Farm.singFarmSong() as a void method that prints the song, but the provided solution implements singFarmSong() with return type String. This return-type mismatch between specification/template (void) and solution (String) is a structural inconsistency that can confuse students about the expected method signature and how to implement or test the song output.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across all artifacts. Preferably change the solution to match the specification/template: modify the solution's singFarmSong() to return void and have it print the song (using System.out.println/System.out.print) rather than returning a String. Alternatively, if the intent is to return the song text, update the problem statement UML and the template method signature to return String and document that the method should return the full song text instead of printing it.
